April Fools 2025

AprilCoins are an event currency. They are currently used to purchase the evolution items for the Mythic units from the April Fools banner and Secret units.

April Fools Portal

The April Fools Portal teleports you to a randomly generated map with 3 paths. There are 30 waves which takes roughly 25 minutes to complete. Along the way you can choose blessings and curses from one of 3 cards. The curse cards can increase the amount of stars you get per wave.

instead of getting to use your own loadout, the game will randomly give you a tower every few seconds that you can place 1 of (you can get multiple of the same tower), there is a chance that instead of getting a tower the player gets a power, there are multiple powers with them being:

  • Refund
  • Random Buff
  • Ritual
  • Merge
  • Clone
  • Astral Gate
  • Astral Summon

sell a selected tower for 100% refund, this only works on ur towers (for some reason u can sell both ur Divine General and other peoples Divine General lol)

apply a random buff (+100% dmg or +100% range) to a selected tower (can be applied to Divine General)

sacrifice a selected tower to spawn a Divine General (max of 1 per player, including if u use this then try to use Shadow sorcerer ability)

Select a unit, will sacerfice all other copys of that unit that you own in the selected towers range in return for a damage buff, (this does not work on farms)

Select a unit, Create a copy of that unit with the same upgrade but base stats (unbuffed)

Triples the chance of getting Astral summon power

replace the slot that astral summon is in with a unit from your original loadout

Winter 2024

Stars are an event currency. They are currently used to purchase the Icy Star, evolution items for the Mythic units from the Icy Star and Secret units from the portals.

Winter Portal

The Winter portal teleports you to a randomly generated map with 3 paths. There are 50 waves which takes roughly 40 minutes to complete. Along the way you can choose blessings and curses from one of 3 cards. The curse cards can increase the amount of stars you get per wave and also increase the drop chance for Enlightenment Portal and Dark Mage Portal upon victory.

Units/skins boosts

Some units and skins boost the amount of stars you receive, the damage the unit does and the chance for secret portals (only within the event).

  • Cream: +20% drop rate
  • Illusionist (Transcended): +40% drop rate
  • Iceclaw (Rebirth): +40% drop rate
  • Joykid Rare skin: +2% drop rate, +5000% damage
  • Magician Rare skin: +2% drop rate, +1000% damage
  • Idol Epic skin: +5% drop rate
  • Spearer Legendary skin: +25 drop rate, +70% damage
  • Gamer Girl Legendary skin: +25% drop rate, +70% damage
  • Origami Legendary skin: +25% drop rate, +100% damage
  • Cherub Legendary skin: +25% drop rate, +75% damage
  • Reliable Student Legendary skin: +25% drop rate, +70% damage
  • Shadowgirl Legendary skin: +25% drop rate, +150% damage
  • Sword Queen Legendary skin: +25% drop rate, +70% damage
  • Golden King Legendary skin: +25% drop rate, +50% damage
  • Menace MythicalMythical skin: +40% drop rate, +100% damage
  • Bloodcry MythicalMythical skin: +40% drop rate, +150% damage

Halloween 2024

Candies are an event currency. They are currently used to purchase the Halloween Star, and evolution items for the mythic units in the Halloween Star.

Halloween Portal

The Halloween portal teleports you to halloween themed maps of previous story worlds. There are 50 waves which takes roughly 40 minutes to complete. Along the way you can choose blessings and curses from one of 3 cards. The curse cards can increase the amount of candies you get per wave and also increase the drop chance of the secret unit Umbra upon victory.

Summer 2023

Pearls are an event currency introduced as part of the summer update. They are currently used to purchase the Summer Star, and evolution items for the mythic units in the Summer Star.

Summer Portals

The Summer Portals are portals used to go into Summer variants of story mode maps (excluding Snowy Town, Hidden Sand Village, Marine's Ford, Ghoul City, Hollow World, Magic Town, Clover Kingdom, Cape Canaveral, Hero City, Virtual Dungeon, Windhym), each portals is assigned with a tier, ranging from tiers 1-12, each tier getting harder with more rewards and assigned with challenges, portals tier 3 and above have a chance to drop the Sea God's Portal, when completed, gives the owner of the portal Poseidon.

Christmas 2022

Stars are an event currency introduced as part of the christmas update. They are currently used to purchase the Frozen Star, and evolution items for the mythic units in the Frozen Star.

Holiday Rewards

Holiday Rewards are a daily stamp that you can claim once you log into the game, the rewards ranging from 250/500 Gems250/500 Gems, Trait Rerolls, and 1000 Stars1000 Stars.

Frozen Portals

The Frozen Portals are portals used to go into frozen variants of story mode maps (excluding Marine's Ford), each portals is assigned with a tier, ranging from tiers 1-12, each tier getting harder with more rewards and assigned with challenges, portals tier 3 and above have a chance to drop the Secret Portal, when completed, gives the owner of the portal Ice Queen.

Halloween 2022

Candies are an event currency introduced as part of update 5.0. They are currently used to purchase XP food, capsules for character skins, Dungeon keys, and Evolution Items.

Spooky Fortune
